analysis:
Examined all supplied patches, BASE/HEAD source and mode metadata against the canonical index and selected definitions. StartCommand+ClusterMember.swift:15-16,62,95-96 adds a default-off drain-response option and enables it for runClusterMember; preparation, roster-key checks, runtime hashing and pair installation remain unchanged. UpdateCommand.swift:107-108,117-118,181-232 adds a cluster-supervisor restart request after installation, checks for existing progress, correlates subsequent progress with request.id, and bounds CLI polling. main.swift:32-34 changes only comments. OnboardingChecks.swift:1257-1262 adds tests requiring both members to report one build before replanning, including missing-response cases. No concrete authorization, encryption, cache-scoping, plaintext exposure or billing regression is established in this scope.
Integration must trace the new control path through ProviderLoopConfig/ProviderLoop drain handling, ClusterPairUpdate file I/O, ClusterServiceAgent and ClusterPairUpdateCycle. Material contracts: owner-only bounded/nonblocking mailbox reads and safe writes (TB-003; analogous T-060), stop-versus-restart arbitration and candidate quarantine/recovery (T-043), admission fencing while accepted pair requests finish (A-018, T-010), and fresh connection-bound authorization after restart (T-053/T-054). UpdateCommand.swift:183-185 does not explicitly put the displayed target version into the request; the supervisor must independently validate installed artifacts and both members' compatible build identities. These implementations are outside the supplied evidence, so their absence here is not a finding. Tests establish intended cases, not production enforcement. No pre-existing cluster deployment or older supervisor behavior is assumed.
